dialogue_segments.text: And the scars... were they from the war?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Reflective, Vulnerable)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.

logline: As Juliana inspects her late mother's weathered herbal grimoire, Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war-worn memories, gently altering her perception of what true wealth means.
continuity_notes: Picks up after Episode 7, where Alexander chased off Gerald and the mocking aristocratic visitors; quiet and intimacy now return inside the woodland cottage as evening approaches.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Playful, Amused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Teasing, Determined)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Instructional, Calm)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.

dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: My mother wrote the same thing.
